title: Compared to What? Calibrating Machine-Unlearning Diagnostics with Present, Absent and Suppressed Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2611.29285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unlearning methods for language models are judged mainly by behaviour, but a model can stop producing an answer while still encoding it. Internal diagnostics such as linear probes, the logit lens and relearning speed are used to tell removal from suppression, yet none has been checked against cases where the answer is known. We build such cases. A present anchor learned a set of synthetic facts; an absent anchor is a never-taught oracle retrained without them; and suppressed anchors are unlearned with their lower layers frozen, so the facts stay encoded below the frozen block by construction. We compare these anchors with NPO, RMU and gradient difference at a matched operating point on GPT-2 Small and Qwen3-0.6B-Base, scoring every diagnostic per entity with AUROC against the oracle. Behaviour cannot separate the suppressed anchors from the oracle (AUROC 0.51 to 0.58), while probes, the logit lens and relearning gain can (0.65 to 1.00),

translated_title: 与什么相比？利用存在、缺失与被抑制的锚点校准机器遗忘诊断方法
translated_abstract: 针对语言模型的机器遗忘方法主要依据行为表现来评判，但模型可能在停止输出某个答案的同时，仍在内部编码着该信息。线性探针、logit lens（逻辑镜头）和再学习速度等内部诊断手段被用于区分“真正删除”与“表面抑制”，然而这些方法此前从未在答案已知的对照案例中经过检验。我们构建了这样的对照案例：“存在锚点”是学习过一组合成事实的模型；“缺失锚点”是一个从未学习过这些事实、在不包含它们的情况下重新训练的先知模型；“被抑制锚点”则是在冻结较低层的情况下执行遗忘的模型，因此在构造上事实必然仍编码于冻结层之下。我们在匹配的操作点上，于GPT-2 Small和Qwen3-0.6B-Base上将这些锚点与NPO、RMU及梯度差分方法进行对比，以先知模型为参照，用AUROC对每个实体的各项诊断指标进行评分。结果表明，行为表现无法将“被抑制锚点”与先知模型区分开（AUROC为0.51至0.58），而线性探针、logit lens和再学习增益则能够做到（0.65至1.00）。
tldr: 本文首次构建了答案已知的“存在、缺失与被抑制”三类锚点对照体系来校准机器遗忘诊断方法，发现行为评估无法检测被抑制的知识（AUROC仅0.51-0.58），而线性探针、logit lens和再学习增益能有效区分真正的知识删除与表面抑制（AUROC达0.65-1.00）。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs the first ground-truth anchor framework (present, absent, and suppressed anchors) with known answers to calibrate machine-unlearning diagnostics, showing that behavioral evaluation cannot detect suppressed knowledge (AUROC 0.51-0.58), while internal diagnostics such as linear probes, the logit lens, and relearning gain can reliably distinguish true removal from suppression (AUROC 0.65-1.00).
